hints: Carry the depth down the recursion and store the key at path[depth]. When the call returns, the next sibling call overwrites that slot - so no explicit 'undo' is needed.
A leaf is a node with BOTH children NULL. Checking only 'root == NULL' prints every path twice (once per missing child).
Carry the running sum as a plain int parameter; each call gets its own copy, which is exactly the backtracking you want.
title: Root-to-leaf paths and path sums
